definitions.rationale: This is the base equation of the splitSpaces recursive summary, defining the split of the empty string as the empty list.
This is a recurrence equation for splitSpaces: when the first character is a space, it defines the result by discarding that separator and recurring on the suffix.
definitions.text:
rule splitSpaces(S) => splitSpaces(substrString(S, 1, lengthString(S)))
    requires lengthString(S) >Int 0
     andBool substrString(S, 0, 1) ==String " "

definitions.rationale: This is a terminal equation for the splitSpaces summary, defining a nonempty string with no space as a singleton word list.
definitions.text:
rule splitSpaces(S) => ListItem(S)
    requires lengthString(S) >Int 0
     andBool findString(S, " ", 0) ==Int -1

definitions.rationale: This is the word-producing recurrence of splitSpaces, defining the result as the prefix before the first space followed by recursively split remaining text.
definitions.text:
rule splitSpaces(S)
    => ListItem(substrString(S, 0, findString(S, " ", 0)))
       splitSpaces(substrString(S, findString(S, " ", 0) +Int 1,
                                  lengthString(S)))
    requires findString(S, " ", 0) >Int 0

definitions.rationale: This equation defines the named wordsContract summary by normalizing commas to spaces and applying splitSpaces.
